# Empora for WooCommerce — Documentation

> Empora for WooCommerce (formerly All-In-One WooCommerce) is a WordPress plugin for WooCommerce stores.
> It ships 82 independently switchable modules. Eight are free and need no license: product filters,
> reviews, wishlist, compare, social, SEO, dynamic pricing and product import/export (core fields). The
> remaining 74 are unlocked by a paid plan and cover advanced shipping, payments, taxes, bulk edit, reports, subscriptions,
> bookings, gift cards, rewards points, multi-currency, email automation, shipment tracking, and
> integrations such as Square, Google Listings & Ads and Klaviyo. HPOS-compatible. Requires WordPress
> 6.2+, WooCommerce 8.0+, PHP 8.1+. The free core stays functional indefinitely without a license.

This is the documentation site (https://empora-docs.aoneahsan.com). Product site: https://empora.aoneahsan.com.

## Status of version 1.0

- Empora 1.0 has not been released yet. No version is published on WordPress.org, CodeCanyon or Google Play.
- Version 1.0 ships with NO payment provider, so there is no self-serve checkout. The paid plans are real and
  the software enforces their limits, but a plan is arranged by contacting the author. The product does have
  paid tiers; the purchase path is simply not open yet.
- All 82 modules register in 1.0 and can be switched on. Which ones a site may enable is decided by its plan.
- Installation is by uploading the plugin ZIP; there is no WordPress.org listing yet.

## Plans

Five tiers. Each includes every module in the tiers below it.

- Free — $0/month, 1 site, 8 modules. Unlimited products, orders and customers; import/export of the core product fields.
- Starter — $19/month, 1 site, 29 modules. Unlimited products, orders and customers; import/export of every product field.
- Professional — $49/month, 1 site, 50 modules. Unlimited products, orders and customers; import/export of every product field.
- Business — $99/month, 3 sites, 71 modules. Unlimited products, orders and customers; import/export of every product field.
- Enterprise — $299/month, unlimited sites, all 82 modules, unlimited everything.

Details: https://empora-docs.aoneahsan.com/pricing
